stem: The area, in square centimeters, of a square is \(x^{2} - 14x + k\), where \(k\) is a constant, and each side of the square is \((x - 7)\) centimeters long, where \(x > 7\). What is the value of \(k\)?
solution: The area is the side squared: \((x - 7)^{2} = x^{2} - 14x + 49\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
k = Poly(expand((x - 7)**2), x).coeff_monomial(1)
assert k == 49
assert expand((x - 7)**2 - (x**2 - 14*x + k)) == 0
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [k]
